Title: Cost still payed for swirlied masters?

Messages.Author: gymim
Messages.Body: If a vampire I control plays an action card that costs blood or pool, and that action is blocked, the blood or pool aren't paid though. Is that correct?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Correct. The cost is paid only if the action is successful.
